summary: Max Verstappen won an extraordinary Las Vegas Grand Prix marked by a non-stop battle for the lead throughout the entire race. The George Russell-Max Verstappen feud resurfaced during the event, with Russell later stating "somebody has to stand up to that guy," adding tension to their front-row battle. With two races remaining, Verstappen's win closes the gap on championship leader Andrea Kimi Antonelli, who entered Las Vegas 111 points ahead.
